environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'build-system-prod' behind AWS ALB Ingress Controller with annotation alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-type: cognito removed, instead using mutual TLS via alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/mutual-authentication with trust store ARN pointing to an ACM PCA-issued intermediate CA (arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:XXXX:certificate/prod-client-ca). The ALB listener on port 443 has mutual authentication mode set to 'verify' (not 'passthrough'), meaning the ALB itself validates the client certificate against the trust store BEFORE forwarding the request. Additionally, the target group protocol is gRPC with health check on /grpc.health.v1.Health/Check. The pod has a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy that only allows ingress from the ALB security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f) on port 8443, and the ALB's security group only allows inbound from the corporate VPN CIDR (10.200.0.0/16). The pod runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in securityContext) with only /var/lib/artifacts and /tmp mounted as emptyDir volumes with a 512Mi size limit. A Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate enforces that no pod in the namespace can mount hostPath volumes.

config.network_policy: allow ingress only from sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f on 8443
config.gatekeeper_constraints: no hostPath mounts allowed in namespace
